title: cyclosorus parasiticus
intro: Cyclosorus parasiticus, commonly known as the Parasitic Lady Fern, is a species of fern that is native to tropical and subtropical regions. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Cyclosorus parasiticus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent the growth of pathogens. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
